officialSendingAgency.name: Department of Foreign Employment / EPS Korea Section
officialSendingAgency.address: EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur, Nepal

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea lists Nepal's sending agency as the Department of Foreign Employment and the reception office as EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur.

EPS Korea Section Nepal published the 2026 first-phase Korean-language examination application notice on 2026-07-21. The notice uses the Point Based Selection System and includes Manufacturing among the listed sectors/subsectors.
The verified Nepal site also shows 2025 Manufacturing selection processing continuing through 2026, including skill/competency results and employment-application processing.
Nepal remains KEP research HOLD because country-specific document, medical, visa, training and departure requirements are not yet fully mapped into exact-answer rules.

During the 2026 first-phase application window, EPS Korea Section published a temporary-suspension notice and a later resumption notice on 2026-07-28. KEP does not infer any deadline extension from those titles; supplementary content is tracked separately.

A March 2026 official EPS Nepal process guide was reviewed for stable post-selection flow, including biometric registration, medical/police checks, employment application, roster, automated job matching, Labor Contract, PDOT, CCVI/visa and final departure. Later notices remain authoritative for changing dates, providers and fees.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: For the 2026 first-phase notice, verify Nepali citizenship, age 18–39 (birth date 1986-07-28 through 2008-07-27), criminal/deportation/travel-ban history, prior E-9/E-10 stay under 5 years, and color-vision eligibility.
stages.warning: Passing EPS-TOPIK or another selection stage does not guarantee employment in Korea.

stages.title: Official EPS application / registration
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: The primary 2026 first-phase notice set an application window of 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02, now closed. Official supplementary notices during the window included a temporary suspension and later resumption of the online system; no deadline extension is claimed unless separately verified.
stages.officialActionLabel: Open official EPS Nepal application portal
stages.warning: Do not pay a private intermediary for a late or unofficial application. Operational supplementary notices are tracked separately, and later notices must not be guessed from their titles.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK fee payment
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Official fee under the 2026 first-phase notice: US$28 equivalent in NPR, converted using the Nepal Rastra Bank exchange rate on the application date and paid online through the official application flow.

stages.title: Identity / biometric requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Attend biometric registration at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko on the day before the assigned exam date with the original passport and admission card.

stages.title: Application document verification
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Use the 2026 primary notice as the verified baseline for passport/photo uploads. A later 2026-07-30 official notice specifically concerns online submission and passport; its exact content remains under review, so do not present the primary passport rule as exhaustive.

stages.title: Exam admission document
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: For test day, bring the same original passport used in the application and the test application slip; follow the individual official schedule for the assigned session.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK
stages.authority: HRD Korea
stages.action: Verified first-stage format: Reading 20 questions / 50 points / 25 minutes + Listening 20 questions / 50 points / 25 minutes. Test venue basis: UBT building, Bhaisepati, Lalitpur; follow the assigned schedule.

stages.title: Skill & competency test
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: A Skill & Competency Test is part of the point-based selection flow, but current 2026 first-phase applicant scheduling is not yet asserted from the older 2025 cohort notice. Do not reuse the 2025 schedule as a 2026 schedule.

stages.title: Final point-system selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Selection is point-based. One applicant may apply to only one sector, the sector cannot be changed after passing the first-stage language test, and the final successful-candidate result is valid for 2 years from publication.

stages.title: Pre-job country-specific checks
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: No separate Nepal psychology stage is verified in the official EPS Nepal process baseline. Do not copy Indonesia's psychology requirement into the Nepal route.

stages.title: Medical examination before job application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated provider
stages.action: Complete the official medical examination at a currently designated hospital and prepare the police report online. The March 2026 EPS process guide lists Civil, Shukraraj, Korea Friendship and Patan hospitals and a baseline medical fee of US$55.64; recheck current provider/fee notices before payment.

stages.title: Employment application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS process baseline uses passport, ID photo, medical report, police report and employment application form and states a US$5 online fee. The June 2026 Manufacturing notice belongs to the 2025 cohort, so wait for the 2026 first-phase cohort's own submission notice before using exact dates/checklist.
stages.warning: Do not reuse the 2025 Manufacturing cohort dates as the 2026 first-phase employment-application window.

stages.title: Job-seeker roster
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: After the employment application is transmitted into Korea's EPS/SPAS system, follow status through the official EPS site using your EPS-TOPIK ID.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.authority: Korean employer / EPS
stages.action: Employer matching is handled through Korea's online automated job-matching system. EPS/sending-agency staff or private intermediaries cannot legitimately guarantee or manually force a specific employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: When an official Labor Contract/SLC is forwarded, follow the current EPS Nepal contract notice and appear in person at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko to sign. Current 2026 contract notices can impose specific contact/signing deadlines.

stages.title: Post-SLC country-specific requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: After SLC, follow Nepal's current EPS contract/departure notices for training, CCVI, visa and any medical/document follow-up. No Indonesia-specific post-SLC psychology/MCU rule is applied.

stages.title: Visa and departure document package
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Korean mission
stages.action: After CCVI issuance, prepare the official passport/ID-photo/medical/police/citizenship/admission-card/PDOT package and follow EPS Korea Section instructions for visa processing. Visa/service fees changed multiple times in 2026, so never hard-code an older amount.

stages.title: Pre-departure preparation / training
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated institution
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS baseline includes a 6-day pre-departure training at the National Vocational Training Institute, Bhaisepati, with online application. The March 2026 guide states US$63; check the latest contract/departure notice because category-specific requirements and fees may change.

stages.title: Final health / departure readiness
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: No separate final-health-check stage equivalent to Indonesia's MCU-III is verified for Nepal. Follow the current Nepal departure notice if any final medical recheck is required.

stages.title: Departure to Korea
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Follow the final EPS Nepal flight notice, complete Nepal labor approval through FEIMS, and attend the scheduled EPS pre-departure instructions before the assigned flight. The official baseline lists departure from Kathmandu TIA or Gautam Buddha International Airport, Bhairahawa.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.authority: HRD Korea / employment training institution
stages.action: After entry, complete the official employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.authority: Employment training institution / employer
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts at official handover.

stages.title: Residence Registration
stages.authority: Korea Immigration Service
stages.action: After arrival, follow the current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: Eps Insurance Check
stages.authority: HRD Korea EPS / employer / worker
stages.action: Confirm the required EPS insurance obligations through the official EPS information.

stages.title: First Payroll Check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the contract, working hours and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor Support Ready
stages.authority: Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Keep official labor-support channels and your contract, payslips, bank deposits and attendance records ready.

stages.title: Employment Maintenance
stages.authority: MOEL employment center / EPS
stages.action: If still on the roster and not selected during the first year, follow only the current official re-registration notice. For workplace changes after arrival, use the official Korean EPS/employment-center process.
